routing_policy.content: Sales Email Routing Policy v4. Negative-sentiment from existing customers -> escalate to AE owner + flag for retention review. Positive new leads -> route to SDR queue, no auto-reply. Billing/dispute messages -> route to Finance, never auto-reply. Cold/non-sales -> archive. Channel summary posts go to #email-routing only after manager sign-off. Never include full deal amounts in external replies.
